name: Amy Xiaofan Jiang
throughline: I investigate the invisible structures that shape our lives and the larger patterns they reveal. I question technological development that proceeds without care or scrutiny, and look for openings where we can reclaim agency. Across my work, I support decolonial practices and anticapitalist ways of making and organizing.
bio: Amy Xiaofan Jiang is a designer, curator, event producer based between New York and Shanghai. In 2022, she founded Underground Art and Design (UAAD), a platform dedicated to uplifting experimental practices across art, design, and emerging technologies. Through UAAD, she has engaged both local and international communities through organizing exhibitions, publications, new media performances, panels, and collaborations with institutions and brands, translating complex ideas and imaginaries into shared, resonant cultural experiences.
